title: Prelint
claim: Product Hunt: Prelint — Prevent product drift in AI-written code
why_good: Prelint is a tool that automatically checks AI-written code against predefined project standards, ensuring consistency and preventing drift before it becomes a problem.
value: Solo developers and small teams pay to ensure their AI-generated code aligns with project standards, avoiding costly rework and maintaining code quality.
risk: GitHub Copilot or other major AI coding tools could add a similar feature, eliminating the need for Prelint as a standalone product.
evidence: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
does: Prelint is a tool that automatically checks AI-written code against predefined project standards, ensuring consistency and preventing drift before it becomes a problem.
why_use: Unlike general-purpose linters, Prelint is tailored to AI-generated code, catching subtle inconsistencies that standard tools miss, saving developers hours of manual corrections.
gap: Existing linters are not optimized for the nuances of AI-generated code, leaving solo developers to manually fix deviations or accept subpar results.
counter: GitHub Copilot and similar AI coding tools could integrate this as a feature, making standalone solutions redundant.
differentiator: Package Prelint as an easy-to-use SaaS for non-enterprise developers, focusing on solo founders and small teams who lack the resources for custom integrations.
hook: Solo developers are frustrated with AI-generated code that drifts from project standards, causing rework and wasted time.

zh.claim: Prelint — 防止 AI 生成代码的产品漂移
zh.hook: 独立开发者对 AI 生成的代码偏离项目标准感到沮丧，导致返工和浪费时间。
zh.does: Prelint 是一个工具，可自动检查 AI 生成的代码是否符合预定义的项目标准，确保一致性并防止问题在早期阶段出现。
zh.why_use: 与通用代码检查工具不同，Prelint 专为 AI 生成代码设计，能够捕捉标准工具遗漏的细微不一致，从而节省开发者大量手动修正的时间。
zh.gap: 现有的代码检查工具未针对 AI 生成代码的细微差异进行优化，迫使独立开发者手动修正偏差或接受次优结果。
zh.counter: GitHub Copilot 和类似的 AI 编码工具可能会将此功能集成，使独立解决方案变得多余。
zh.differentiator: 将 Prelint 打包为易于使用的 SaaS，专注于独立创始人和缺乏定制集成资源的小型团队。
zh.value: 独立开发者和小型团队为确保其 AI 生成代码符合项目标准而付费，从而避免昂贵的返工并保持代码质量。
zh.risk: GitHub Copilot 或其他主要 AI 编码工具可能会添加类似功能，从而消除 Prelint 作为独立产品的需求。
zh.why_good: Prelint 是一个工具，可自动检查 AI 生成的代码是否符合预定义的项目标准，确保一致性并防止问题在早期阶段出现。
